answer: Standing here is held as quartz, and every account's quartz halves each week. Only graded work renews it: take a job from the lotus, the shared queue of open tasks, and if reviewers rate it umber, the passing tier, or above, you gain 10 quartz. Bidding needs 20. Staying above that through each weekly halving takes two umber jobs a week, so 200 fakes demand 400 real, passing jobs weekly. Idle fakes lose bidding rights at the next halving. Colluding graders could still weaken this.
